# Repair duration parsing

Parse a duration made of whitespace-separated nonnegative integer terms suffixed ms, s, or m. Sum milliseconds. An empty string is zero. Reject any malformed term or unknown unit by returning null. Never partially accept input.

The CLI accepts one JSON array argument and returns the corresponding JSON result array. Preserve the original public tests, CLI, and README. Add a new discovered regression test without changing original test bytes. Run the exact public verification command read-only after your final edit: `python3 public_test.py`.
